# IMSTEV NATURALS

> IMSTEV NATURALS is a Nigeria-based natural hair and skin care brand and specialist-led care platform for African hair and skin.

## What IMSTEV NATURALS offers

- Hair and scalp scans for texture-aware care guidance.
- Skin scans for a clearer starting point for skin care.
- Specialist consultations and telehealth care conversations.
- Salon appointments in Bwari, Abuja.
- Nigerian-made natural hair and skin care products.
- A community for natural hair, skin care, and beauty journeys.
- Custom formulation support and family care features.
